negativeResult.collection: New England's Hidden Histories digitized colonial church records (Braintree, Weymouth, Mendon, Dorchester, Boston First)
limitations: The earliest Braintree First Church records digitized here begin 1697 (Samuel Niles journal); Boston First begins 1690 (the 1630-87 book is the CSM 39 print); Dorchester First 1727; Weymouth and Mendon are absent - nothing pre-1690 for John's orbit.
A holdings check confirms the aggregator holds no relevant book; it is not a name-level search of a book that would have covered John.
The pre-1690 Braintree church book is itself lost, so this is a coverage gap in the surviving record as much as in the digitization.

statement: New England's Hidden Histories (Congregational Library) holds no pre-1690 church material for John Gurney's towns - Braintree First begins 1697, Boston First 1690, Dorchester First 1727, with no Weymouth or Mendon book - so this specialist colonial-church index adds no record of him.
